The listener has heard something previously communicated by the speaker.
Sharing the content with others is encouraged by the speaker.
The speaker believes listeners may enjoy the content they have shared.

assumptions.text: The audience values the speaker’s work enough to consider sharing it.
The speaker views themselves as approachable and open to communication.
The audience trusts the speaker’s judgment regarding what is worth sharing.
Contacting the speaker via email is considered a legitimate and expected form of interaction.
